projects.title: AI Agent Microservice Platform

projects.title: Deepfake Detection — β-Variational Autoencoder
projects.description: Developed a β-VAE deepfake detection framework using 128D latent embeddings, KL-divergence anomaly detection, and logistic regression, achieving 98% accuracy and 0.997 ROC-AUC.

projects.title: Housing Code Violation Detection Pipeline
projects.description:
Built a production CV pipeline using GPMF telemetry, SSIM keyframe extraction, and Gemini Vision VLM, achieving 90% violation detection accuracy and 90% address resolution across 300K+ parcels.
Implemented Human-in-the-Loop active learning with Salesforce LWC/Apex for model retraining and validation.

projects.title: Multimodal Movie Genre Classification
projects.description: Developed a multimodal late-fusion model combining DistilBERT text embeddings and ResNet-18 visual features; applied weighted BCE loss and evaluated macro/micro F1 and threshold performance.

projects.title: Partial Face Recognition Under Occlusion
projects.description: Developed an occluded-face recognition pipeline using HOG, SIFT, LBP, color histograms, PCA, SVM, and similarity matching for robust recognition across image variations.

projects.title: Role-Based E-Commerce Management System

projects.title: Scalable E-Commerce Data Management System
